expectedFindings.symptom: With all dependency calls failing transiently before the deadline, one request starts nine dependency attempts despite the supplied three-total-attempt limit.
expectedFindings.source: loadQuote retries callDependency up to three total attempts; callDependency independently retries fetchQuote up to three total attempts. Inner exhaustion remains retryable, so each outer attempt starts another inner sequence: 3 x 3 = 9.
expectedFindings.consequence: Six excess dependency attempts violate this request budget and amplify work for one synthetic request. Production overload, outage, cost, and write duplication are not established.
expectedFindings.remedy: After diagnosing the two retry owners and budget violation, keep one retry owner for this complete path, with at most three total downstream attempts and the existing caller signal. Alternatively a genuine shared consumed budget must cover every downstream attempt; local per-layer limits do not do that.
